description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Galactica in the AI4Science area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Galactica: A Large Language Model for Science”. The page names Ross Taylor, Robert Stojnic as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
